screens.title: CTA — приглашение в игру
screens.detail: Attract/start screen. Exact headline "Открой возможности MAX", subtitle "Создавай своё пространство и выполняй задания", frosted violet pill CTA "Начать". Arrange five semantic glass tiles in an asymmetrical loose constellation behind and beside the text: video camera, chat bubbles, ID card, megaphone, storefront. Some are larger than others, with generous breathing room, no linear chain, no numbers, no thick enclosing rectangle. Main CTA is dominant. Three of the tiles carry modest violet notification dots. This introduces a game of exploring objects and tasks, NOT collecting a numeric sequence.

screens.title: Выбор миссии — смысловые иконки
screens.detail: Mission selection screen. Exact heading "Выбери миссию". Four spacious translucent violet pill cards in a balanced 2x2 layout, each with a large circular pictogram medallion protruding slightly above one edge and a short description. NO number badges. Cards: megaphone+audience pictogram and title "Стать блогером"; ID-card pictogram and title "Все возможности с Цифровым ID"; chat/video pictogram and title "Общение"; storefront/briefcase pictogram and title "Продвижение бизнеса". Supporting line "У каждой миссии — свои объекты и задания". Refined glass layering, thin outline, white icons and text, cyan used sparingly.

screens.title: Иконка с заданием — окно приложения
screens.detail: A placed icon has been tapped, opening its task interface. Clearly depict one COMPACT COMPOSITE TASK OVERLAY above a softly dimmed free object field, following the supplied task-window reference. Left: translucent violet instruction pane with exact title "Создай Цифровой ID", instruction "Открой раздел «Цифровой ID» в демо-профиле", a large rounded-square ID-card pictogram, and a small attached violet notification badge "!". Right: a stylized vertical app-like rounded rectangle integrated with the instruction pane, NOT a photorealistic physical phone, no hardware frame. In-app title "Демо-профиль", generic white avatar silhouette, list rows "Цифровой ID", "Уведомления", "Приватность", "Сообщения". The "Цифровой ID" row has a clear cyan-violet focus outline and right chevron inviting a tap. Small line "Учебный экран". Close X attached to top right of the WHOLE task overlay. Background retains 3 faint freely positioned glass icon objects at varied XY coordinates, not a row. Task NOT yet completed; don't show checkmark success yet. No real name, phone number or fabricated QR code.

screens.title: Задание выполнено — изменение состояния
screens.detail: Same composite task overlay as the task-screen reference, now task successfully completed. Left instruction pane title "Цифровой ID создан", copy "Теперь попробуй его возможности", large ID-card pictogram with small WHITE CHECK inside violet circular badge replacing notification "!". Right app-like rounded rectangle: title "Цифровой ID", a stylized demo identity card with generic avatar silhouette and white checkmark, no actual identity data, no fake scannable QR. Text "Готово" and "Учебный экран". One primary pill action "Вернуться на поле". Close X at top right. Keep background free-positioned icon field dimmed. This is a success state for ONE OBJECT TASK, not the whole mission, no "Все миссии пройдены".

screens.title: Общий финал
screens.detail: Overall game finale. Exact dominant headline "Все миссии выполнены" and supporting line "Ты открыл возможности MAX". Four semantic glass medallions in a celebratory yet calm asymmetrical constellation: megaphone «Блогер», ID-card «Цифровой ID», conversation bubbles «Общение», storefront «Бизнес». Each has a small white checkmark badge, no numbers at all. Elegant connections only as soft organic flowing fibers, NO rank podium, no horizontal pipeline, no confetti, stars, awards or invented prizes. Two pill CTAs below "Выбрать миссию" and "Начать заново". A broad violet light sweep creates a polished completion atmosphere.
